It runs as a standalone HTTP server that translates KServe V2 REST Predict Protocol requests into gRPC V2 Predict Protocol calls using gRPC-Gateway. It is deployed as a sidecar container alongside ModelMesh Serving. The project builds a container image with a single Go binary that listens on an HTTP port (default 8008) and forwards inference requests to a gRPC backend (default port 8033).
